name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted music streaming server with a browser player, multi-user accounts, folder view and Last.fm scrobbling for your own audio files.

alerts.message: The first visitor creates the admin account in the onboarding screen, so open the app right after deploying.
Swing Music has no upload feature: copy your audio files into the music volume (mounted at /music) and pick it as a root folder during onboarding.
